preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 30.
Each test case must have an integer N between 2 and 1000.
The total sum of N across all test cases must not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly T * N integers, one for each element in the permutations.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) in range(1, N + 1) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output must be within the range from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(P[:i])) == i for i in range(1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: Each prefix of the permutation must contain unique elements.

postconditions.expression: all(median(P[:i]) != median(P[:i + 1]) for i in range(N - 1))
postconditions.description: The medians of consecutive prefixes must not be equal.
